name: retract-window
title: Retract Window
description: Under a sent message: how long Edit and Unsend stay open on that platform (iMessage, WhatsApp, Slack presets or your own), a draining bar, who already read it and whose app keeps the original, Delete for me kept apart, and a correction once windows close.

meta.stops: Trusted an unsend that didn't work
meta.summary: Shows how long Edit and Unsend really stay open for a sent message, and who will keep the original anyway.
catches: Time left to edit and to unsend, per the platform's rules
Recipients who already read it or whose app keeps the original
"Delete for me" labelled as leaving everyone else's copy
Who still has it after an unsend, and a correction once windows close
limits: Presets reflect the platforms' help pages as of the verified date and change without notice
Slack windows depend on each workspace's admin settings; pass the real limits
Does not edit or unsend; your callbacks do, and a failed unsend shows an error
a11y: Edit/Unsend buttons are described by their window text (aria-describedby)
Only a window closing is announced (role=status), never the countdown
Failures use role=alert; after unsend, focus moves to the result
The draining bar is aria-hidden; time left is also text

sources.label: Apple – Unsend and edit messages on iPhone
Slack – Manage permissions for message editing and deletion

rules.note: Confirmed: iMessage unsend 2 min, edit up to 5 times within 15 min; WhatsApp edit 15 min, Delete for everyone within two days; Slack members can edit/delete any time by default, admins can limit. Check the platforms' current help pages.
